purpose: Summarize why publishing cannot proceed, which review queues own the blockers, and what should happen next without triggering real publishing.
fixed_rules: If any redline blocker exists, publish_decision must be blocked.
If any four-piece item is missing, publish_decision must be pending_supplement_or_blocked.
If multi-platform check is incomplete, do not conclude one-click all-platform publishing is ready.
This template only summarizes blockers and does not supplement, send messages, or publish.
